payload.text:
# @NASAAdmin: It will never get old seeing Kennedy Space Center from the…

**Source:** https://x.com/NASAAdmin/status/2020984085754282078

# NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman (@NASAAdmin) on X

**Source:** https://x.com/NASAAdmin/status/2020984085754282078

*2 posts captured: the shared post and the earlier posts in the author's own chain. Replies below the shared post aren't served by X's public endpoint.*

## 1/2
It will never get old seeing Kennedy Space Center from the air--especially with two human-rated rockets standing vertical on Pads 39B and 40 for Artemis II and Crew-12.

It was an honor to share the skies with @AFThunderbirds Thunderbird 7, Lt. Col. Tyler Keener, Thunderbird 8, https://t.co/PYgaWULbPH

*2026-02-09T22:11:30.000Z · video (capture it with the regular Uoink button)*

## 2/2
https://t.co/DLb2immna5

*2026-02-09T22:12:08.000Z · 4 photos*
